/* ============================================================================= MORWE HOLDINGS — Interactive Launchpad Motion Features ============================================================================= */ /* 1. Floating Background Accent (Subtle, slow-moving emerald orb) */ .launchpad-bg-effect { position: absolute; top: 10%; right: -10%; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.08) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%); border-radius: 50%; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; animation: morweFloat 15s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } @keyframes morweFloat { 0% { transform: translateY(0px) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translateY(-20px) scale(1.05); } 100% { transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.95); } } /* 2. Floating Launchpad Icon Hover (Adds a vertical hover float to cards) */ .launchpad-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: transform $transition-bounce, box-shadow $transition-base; } .launchpad-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); /* Clean, dynamic vertical leap */ box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.15); } /* 3. The "Request Access" Action Pulse (Subtle ambient light shift) */ @keyframes buttonPulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.4); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(45, 106, 79, 0); } } button[id="submit-btn"], button.btn-primary.btn-block, .sp-order-now { animation: buttonPulse 3s infinite; }
